room_rent.note: Policy wording does not specify any room rent cap or entitlement; Schedule (Part a) would contain specifics.

icu.note: ICU charges are listed as reimbursable but no cap or limit is stated in the wording.

copayment.note: No co-payment clause found in the wording; deductible applies per claim instead.

sub_limits.note: Specified Treatments (cataract, dialysis, chemotherapy, etc.) are listed but no sub-limits/caps are stated in the wording; Schedule may contain them.

deductible.note: A deductible is referenced and applies per claim, but the amount is stated in Part a of the Schedule, not in the wording.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; 90-day waiting for hypertension, diabetes, cardiac conditions.

ped_waiting.note: Pre-existing diseases excluded for 36 months from first policy inception.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions include cataract, hernia, hydrocele, joint replacements, stones, arthritis, sinusitis, skin tumours, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard permanent exclusion (Excl18); ectopic pregnancy is the only exception.

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative/no-claim bonus mentioned in the wording.

restoration.note: No restoration or reinstatement benefit mentioned in the wording.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses are defined but the number of days is not stated in the wording; Schedule would specify.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses are defined but the number of days is not stated in the wording; Schedule would specify.

day_care.note: Day care treatment covered for specified procedures (Specified Treatments list); general day care not explicitly broadened.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary Hospitalisation is explicitly listed as a permanent exclusion.

ayush.note: AYUSH hospitals and AYUSH day care centres are included in definitions; in-patient AYUSH treatment appears covered under the main benefit.

organ_donor.note: Costs of donor screening or treatment including surgery to remove organs from a donor are explicitly excluded.

ambulance.note: Ambulance charges are explicitly listed as a permanent exclusion (item xix).

modern_treatments.note: No mention of modern/robotic treatments in the wording.

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-payable consumables (gloves, nebuliser kit, etc.) per IRDAI list; no consumables cover rider mentioned.

global_cover.note: Cover is restricted to India; treatment outside geographical scope is excluded. International cover possible only by written endorsement.

moratorium.note: Moratorium period not explicitly stated in the wording.

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly premium mode; 30 days for all other modes.

free_look.note: Free-look period referenced in cancellation clause but duration not stated in the wording.

portability.note: Portability to another insurer allowed; apply at least 30 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions: Ambulance charges, domiciliary hospitalisation, organ donor costs, sleep disorders/apnoea, dental (non-accident), cochlear implants (non-accident), external congenital anomalies
insurer: ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company Ltd.
